paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.28 as of September 29, representing a 0.47% increase from the prior close and a 13.88% decrease over the past 21 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has been in the news recently due to its partnership with NAES to operate and maintain natural gas generation for its 17-GW Texas data center campus, as reported by Hart Energy on September 29. This development is part of the company's Project Matador.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a total of 25 filings, with 3 of them being Form 4 filings. The company has also filed a Form 8-K on August 31, which announced the scheduling of its first annual meeting of stockholders. Additionally, there have been insider transactions reported on Form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18.
